principle_violations.reason: The Order class manages both the order details (items, quantities, prices) and the order status. Additionally, the PaymentProcessor class directly modifies the order status.
principle_violations.suggestion: Create a separate class to manage order status updates, and keep the Order class focused solely on order details.

principle_violations.reason: The PaymentProcessor directly depends on the concrete implementation of the Order class. If the Order class is modified, the PaymentProcessor will also need to be modified.
principle_violations.suggestion: Define an interface for payment processing that abstracts the details of how payments are processed. This allows for different implementations without changing the existing code.

overall_feedback: 2 principle violations found. Please see the details below.
